# plural_dashboard (Resource)

Workbench dashboard resource. A dashboard arranges graphs, backed by workbench observability tools, on a grid.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Dashboard name, unique within its workbench.
- `workbench_id` (String) ID of the workbench that owns this dashboard. A dashboard cannot be moved to a different workbench.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Dashboard description.
- `graphs` (Attributes List) Graphs arranged on the dashboard grid. Graph identifiers have to be unique within the dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--graphs))
- `inputs` (Attributes List) User-configurable dashboard variables. Input names have to be unique within the dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inputs))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal identifier of this dashboard.

<a id="nestedatt--graphs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `graphs`

Required:

- `identifier` (String) Stable identifier of the graph, unique within the dashboard.
- `layout` (Attributes) Grid position and size of the graph. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--graphs--layout))
- `type` (String) Graph visualization type. `SECTION` graphs group other graphs and `MARKDOWN` graphs require `markdown`. Allowed values include `TIMESERIES`, `GAUGE`, `LOGS`, `MARKDOWN`, `TABLE`, `STAT`, `BAR`, `PIE`, `HEATMAP`, `TRACES` and `SECTION`.

Optional:

- `datasource` (Attributes) Observability tool call used to fetch data for the graph. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--graphs--datasource))
- `description` (String) Graph description.
- `markdown` (String) Markdown content for `MARKDOWN` graphs.
- `options` (String) JSON-encoded visualization-specific display options, e.g. `jsonencode({ collapsed = true })` for sections.
- `section_id` (String) Identifier of the `SECTION` graph containing this graph. Sections cannot be nested.
- `title` (String) Graph title.

<a id="nestedatt--graphs--layout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `graphs.layout`

Required:

- `h` (Number) Height in grid rows.
- `w` (Number) Width in grid columns.
- `x` (Number) Zero-based horizontal grid coordinate.
- `y` (Number) Zero-based vertical grid coordinate.


<a id="nestedatt--graphs--datasource"></a>
### Nested Schema for `graphs.datasource`

Required:

- `tool` (String) Name of the workbench observability tool used to fetch the data.
- `type` (String) Kind of data returned by the datasource. Allowed values include `LOGS`, `METRICS`, `TRACES` and `LABELS`.

Optional:

- `input` (String) JSON-encoded input passed to the tool, e.g. `jsonencode({ query = "up" })`. Defaults to an empty object.



<a id="nestedatt--inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inputs`

Required:

- `name` (String) Variable name referenced by graph datasource inputs.
- `type` (String) Input control type. Allowed values include `TEXT`, `NUMBER`, `BOOLEAN`, `SELECT` and `TIME_RANGE`.

Optional:

- `datasource` (Attributes) Tool query used to populate input options, e.g. a metric label search. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inputs--datasource))
- `default` (String) Default input value.
- `description` (String) Input description.
- `label` (String) Human-readable input label.
- `options` (List of String) Allowed values for `SELECT` inputs.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether a value is required when rendering. Defaults to `false`.

<a id="nestedatt--inputs--datasource"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inputs.datasource`

Required:

- `tool` (String) Name of the workbench observability tool used to fetch the data.
- `type` (String) Kind of data returned by the datasource. Allowed values include `LOGS`, `METRICS`, `TRACES` and `LABELS`.

Optional:

- `input` (String) JSON-encoded input passed to the tool, e.g. `jsonencode({ query = "up" })`. Defaults to an empty object.
